fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-12-20 states that two persons allegedly entered Ponni Medicals near Amudham Garden Market Road in Salem and took cash of about Rs. 1,00,000 after threatening the staff, on 2025-12-20 around 12:10 hrs. The online submission was made by Latha Murugan (9000000037). The complainant is associated with the business Ponni Medicals. The complaint mentions Karthik Balan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000380, in connection with the events. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00280, as the mobile number 9000000380 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Cash reportedly taken from the counter after staff were intimidated.
fields.Keywords: shop robbery, cash, afternoon, market road, mobile number, CCTV, suspect
